scenarios.name: Hero Section Display and Content
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays product name, tagline, value proposition, and primary CTAs prominently (REQ-1, REQ-4)

steps.description: Load the MirDB product homepage in a browser
steps.context: Homepage must be accessible at the root URL

steps.description: Check that 'MirDB' product name is prominently displayed in the hero section
steps.context: Product name should be visible above the fold

steps.description: Confirm the tagline 'Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol' is displayed
steps.context: Tagline should appear near the product name

steps.description: Check that a 2-3 sentence description explaining MirDB's value is present
steps.context: Description should communicate what MirDB is and why it matters

steps.description: Confirm 'Get Started' (primary) and 'View on GitHub' (secondary) CTAs are visible
steps.context: CTAs should be clearly distinguishable and actionable

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Product name 'MirDB' is visible in hero section with font size >= 32px
Tagline contains 'Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol'
Value proposition text mentions 'Rust', 'Memcached protocol', and 'LSM tree'
Button with text 'Get Started' exists and is styled as primary action
Button/link with text 'View on GitHub' exists and links to GitHub repository

scenarios.name: Features Section Content and Layout
scenarios.description: Verify the features section presents key capabilities in an organized format (REQ-2)

steps.description: Navigate to the features section of the homepage
steps.context: Features section should be accessible via scroll or navigation

steps.description: Check for feature card explaining Memcached protocol support
steps.context: Should mention drop-in replacement and standard protocol

steps.description: Check for feature card explaining persistent storage
steps.context: Should mention data surviving restarts and SSTable storage

steps.description: Check for feature card explaining high performance
steps.context: Should mention LSM tree architecture and async I/O

steps.description: Confirm each feature card has icon, title, and description
steps.context: Consistent card layout across all features

test_cases.expected: Features section exists with at least 3 feature cards
Card with title containing 'Memcached' and description mentioning 'protocol' or 'compatible'
Card with title containing 'Persistent' and description mentioning 'SSTable' or 'disk'
Card with title containing 'Performance' and description mentioning 'LSM' or 'async'
Each feature card contains an icon/image element, heading, and paragraph

scenarios.name: Code Examples Section Functionality
scenarios.description: Verify code examples demonstrate basic usage with proper syntax highlighting (REQ-3)

steps.description: Navigate to the code examples section of the homepage
steps.context: Code examples should be clearly visible and organized

steps.description: Check for code example showing how to connect using memcached client
steps.context: Should show Python or similar client connection code

steps.description: Check for code example demonstrating SET operation
steps.context: Should show storing a value with mc.set()

steps.description: Check for code example demonstrating GET operation
steps.context: Should show retrieving a value with mc.get()

steps.description: Verify copy-to-clipboard functionality works for code blocks
steps.context: Users should be able to copy code examples easily

test_cases.expected: At least 2 code blocks exist with <pre> and <code> elements
Code block contains memcache.Client and connection string '127.0.0.1:12333'
Code block contains mc.set() or equivalent SET operation
Code block contains mc.get() or equivalent GET operation
Code blocks have syntax highlighting classes applied (prism or highlight.js)
Copy button/icon exists for each code block
Python code examples are syntactically correct and copy-paste ready

scenarios.name: Architecture Overview Section
scenarios.description: Verify architecture section displays LSM tree data flow diagram and explanation (REQ-5)

steps.description: Navigate to the architecture overview section
steps.context: Section should be accessible via scroll or navigation

steps.description: Check that a visual diagram of LSM tree architecture exists
steps.context: Diagram should be SVG or high-quality image

steps.description: Check for explanation of write path (WAL, Memtable)
steps.context: Should explain durability through write-ahead log

steps.description: Check for explanation of read path (Memtable to SSTables)
steps.context: Should explain how reads check memtable first

test_cases.expected: Architecture section exists with heading containing 'Architecture' or 'How it Works'
SVG or image element exists showing LSM tree structure
Diagram has descriptive alt text for accessibility
Text content mentions 'WAL' or 'Write-Ahead Log' for durability
Text content mentions 'compaction' process

scenarios.name: Getting Started and Installation Section
scenarios.description: Verify installation instructions and quick-start guide are present (REQ-8)

steps.description: Navigate to the getting started/installation section
steps.context: Section should be easy to find for new users

steps.description: Check for cargo install or build from source instructions
steps.context: Should show clear installation steps

steps.description: Check for basic configuration example
steps.context: Should show how to run MirDB with config file

steps.description: Check for link to full documentation
steps.context: Should provide path to detailed docs

test_cases.expected: Section exists with heading containing 'Getting Started' or 'Installation'
Code block contains 'git clone' command for MirDB repository
Code block contains 'cargo build --release' command
Code block shows how to run MirDB with config file (mirdb.toml)
Link to documentation exists and is functional

steps.context: Links should not be broken

steps.description: Check that external links have proper security attributes

scenarios.name: Page Load Performance
scenarios.description: Verify page loads within 3 seconds on standard connection (NFR-1)

steps.description: Measure time to first contentful paint
steps.context: Target under 3 seconds on broadband

steps.description: Check that images and assets are optimized
steps.context: Images should be compressed, CSS/JS minimized

steps.description: Run Lighthouse performance audit
steps.context: Target score of 90+

test_cases.expected: Page fully loads within 3 seconds on simulated broadband connection
Total page weight is under 1MB (excluding optional lazy-loaded content)
Lighthouse performance score is 90 or higher
Images use modern formats (WebP) or are appropriately compressed
Critical CSS is inlined or no render-blocking stylesheets

scenarios.name: Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Verify page meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines (NFR-3)

steps.description: Verify proper heading hierarchy and semantic elements
steps.context: h1 -> h2 -> h3 structure, nav, main, footer elements

steps.description: Verify text has sufficient color contrast
steps.context: 4.5:1 minimum for normal text, 3:1 for large text

steps.description: Verify all interactive elements are keyboard accessible
steps.context: Tab navigation should work logically

steps.description: Verify page works with screen readers
steps.context: All images have alt text, form labels present

test_cases.expected: Page has exactly one h1, h2s follow h1, h3s follow h2s (no skipped levels)
Page uses semantic elements: header, nav, main, section, footer
All images have descriptive alt attributes
All text has minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against background
All interactive elements are reachable and usable via keyboard (Tab, Enter)
Focused elements have visible focus indicators
axe or similar tool reports no critical accessibility violations
